scenes.headline: How Kimi K3.1 Pro improved without a new network
scenes.sub: Same weights' shape, much more reinforcement learning.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bowline! Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot's new flagship. The surprise is what didn't change: the network.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: K3.1 Pro keeps K3's architecture and spends substantially more compute on reinforcement learning, across hundreds of domains at once.
scenes.mark: substantially more compute on reinforcement learning
scenes.say: K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of K3. Same experts, same attention, same window. The gains came from a much bigger reinforcement learning budget.

steps.say: Start from the K3 checkpoint. The policy keeps the same shape.
Most of the cost is generation: long agent runs against tools, in sandboxes across hundreds of domains.
Every domain has its own reward. One buggy environment can teach the wrong thing, so Moonshot vets them on a shared platform.
Then update, and around again. The claim is that extra compute now pays off predictably.

left.title: Kimi K3
left.say: K3 trained nine separate experts, then distilled them into one model.

right.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
items: Joint RL across hundreds of domains
right.say: K3.1 Pro runs joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of domains, and strips cyber data, even from mid-training.

scenes.title: How Highspeed is probably faster
scenes.say: Moonshot hasn't said how Highspeed is faster. This is my reasoning, not theirs.

items.say: Both endpoints list the same model and the same precision.
Serve fewer users per copy, and each user's step gets shorter.
Or draft more tokens ahead, and discard more.
Either way, each token costs more GPU time. That fits a doubled price.

scenes.credit: Moonshot, Kimi K3.1 Pro tech blog
scenes.title: The launch chart, Moonshot's numbers

steps.say: On Terminal-Bench four point oh, K3.1 Pro nearly ties Claude Opus five point five.
It leads on agentic, tool-using work like OfficeQA Pro, and trails on closed-book knowledge and cyber.

scenes.title: Kimi Hallu Bench Hard, claim-level
scenes.note: an internal stress test, lower is better
scenes.say: The sixty-five percent drop is this internal stress test, checked claim by claim. GPT-6 Astra is still lower.

scenes.text: A new flagship can be the same network with a much larger reinforcement learning bill.
scenes.say: The lesson: a new flagship can be the same network, trained much harder afterwards.

recap: Same K3 shape, more reinforcement learning
scenes.say: Same shape, more reinforcement learning, a lead on agentic work, and weights promised for November.
